concepts.name: Slope Of A Line
concepts.simple_definition: The slope measures the steepness and direction of a straight line, defined as rise over run.
concepts.deep_explanation: For any two points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2), slope m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1). Parallel lines have equal slopes; perpendicular lines have slopes that multiply to -1.
concepts.real_example: A line passing through (1, 2) and (3, 6) has a slope of (6 - 2) / (3 - 1) = 2.
concepts.common_confusion: Mixing up the coordinates, putting x changes on top of y changes.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ስሎፕ ማለት የአንድን ቀጥተኛ መስመር አቅጣጫ እና ዳገትነት የሚለካ ሲሆን፣ በቁመት ለውጥ ለጎን ለውጥ ይገለጻል።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: በማንኛውም ሁለት ነጥቦች መካከል ያለው ስሎፕ m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1) ነው። ትይዩ መስመሮች እኩል ስሎፕ አላቸው።
concepts.real_example_amharic: በ (1, 2) እና (3, 6) ውስጥ የሚያልፍ መስመር ስሎፕ (6 - 2) / (3 - 1) = 2 ነው።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: የነጥቦቹን ቅደም ተከተል ማደናገር፣ የ x ለውጥን ከላይ የ y ለውጥን ከታች ማድረግ።
